Metadata.Title: The Dealers
Metadata.Description: We tracked down 5 dealers that are dealing highly dangers weapons from our research team to innocent civilians, you have to take them out immediately. Yuki Yamazaki is the main one that stole them, the other 4 are the ones that took out our soldiers when they stole. Please do this quickly as we have an insider saying that amped security Bulldozers are approaching. Also you can  try to do this without anyone seeing, but thats very hard.I'll leave you to prepare, good luck 47.
